_comment: Hand-kept register of SSRN postings (SSRN is behind Cloudflare and cannot be scraped). Key = SSRN abstract id. posted = Date Created, revised = Last Updated, both from the SSRN author dashboard (last copied 2026-10-31). status.py compares revised (else posted) with the local draft's last commit. arxiv_pending = submissions made but not yet announced (no id yet), keyed by the submit/ number; remove the line once the paper has an arXiv id and add that id to the paper's links in papers.json.
